author: worker_1
object: Game of Thrones SAG Ensemble Award
belief: Game of Thrones was nominated for the Screen Actors Guild Award for Outstanding Performance by an Ensemble in a Drama Series six times (Seasons 1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7).

author: worker_1
object: Game of Thrones SAG Ensemble Award
belief: Game of Thrones never won the Screen Actors Guild Award for Outstanding Performance by an Ensemble in a Drama Series.

author: worker_1
belief: The claim that Ned Stark's cast was nominated and successful (won) is REFUTED because they were nominated but never won the Ensemble award.

author: worker_2
belief: The cast of Game of Thrones won the Screen Actors Guild Award for Outstanding Performance by an Ensemble in a Drama Series in 2016 (22nd SAG Awards).
